theme: Largest set with no string a subsequence of another
title: Marker-Ledger Layering: Weighted Subsequence Antichains
strategies: baseline: the full length-1 layer only (all `a` single-character strings)

single-length commit: find the one length whose weight*min(cap,a**length,T) is highest and fill only that length up to its cap -- a valid antichain, but wastes any alphabet/budget left over once that length's cap is hit

alphabet-partition layering (Dilworth-style): dedicate disjoint digit subsets to several different lengths at once (same-length strings are automatically incomparable, and cross-length strings built from disjoint alphabets can never be scattered subsequences of one another either), then knapsack-DP over (digits spent, budget spent) to pick which lengths to activate and how many digits to give each
